intro: The Way of the Hunter is an introductory training quest for fledgling hunters in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. After proving their mettle against the local vuldren threat, young trackers are directed by Rorian the Dayseeker to present themselves to Tai'ree Farsight to begin their formal tutelage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident hunter trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The way of the hunter is fraught with danger, and only those with the keenest senses and quickest reflexes can thrive in the wilds. I look at you and I am reminded of myself when I stood before my mentor, so many years ago. I believe that you have what it takes, but in the end that is up to you alone.
Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
